priorityList: Apply Arcane Intellect and use Mirror Image before combat.
Start combat by casting Frostfire Bolt or Pyroblast.
Activate Combustion at the end of a Frostfire Bolt, Meteor, or hard-cast Pyroblast cast.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, Racials, and Power Infusion while Combustion is active, ideally when more than 6 seconds remain.
Cast Meteor during Combustion, ideally when more than 2 seconds remain in the window.
Prioritize spending Hot Streak procs on instant Pyroblasts.
Use Fire Blast while casting Frostfire Bolt or hard-casting Pyroblast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak, especially during Combustion.
Hard-cast Pyroblast when the Pyroclasm buff is active, provided the cast finishes within the Combustion window.
Outside of Combustion, spend Hot Streak on Pyroblast if the target is above 90% health (Firestarter) or if Combustion cooldown is greater than 5 seconds.
Use Scorch when Heat Shimmer is active or as a filler when the target is below 30% health.
Use Meteor as a filler when Combustion is nearly ready to be used.
Outside of Combustion, hard-cast Pyroblast when Pyroclasm is at 2 stacks or when Combustion cooldown is greater than 12 seconds.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as your primary filler to generate Heating Up and stacks.
